actionConfiguration.body:
query GetWalletDetails {
  getWalletDetails {
    id
    taxpayerId
    currency
    balanceEgp
    dailyUsedEgp
    monthlyUsedEgp
    dailyLimitCapEgp
    monthlyLimitCapEgp
    dailyProgressPercent
    monthlyProgressPercent
    tierLevel
  }
}

query GetInvoiceFeed {
  getInvoiceFeed {
    id
    internalId
    issuerTrn
    receiverName
    receiverTrn
    documentType
    netAmountEgp
    taxAmountVatEgp
    totalAmountEgp
    status
    etaUuid
    qrCodeUrl
    canonicalHash
    createdAt
  }
}

mutation ProcessWalletDeposit($amount: Float!, $channel: String!, $referenceNumber: String) {
  processWalletDeposit(amount: $amount, channel: $channel, referenceNumber: $referenceNumber) {
    success
    code
    transactionId
    newBalance
    dailyUsedEgp
    monthlyUsedEgp
    attemptedAmount
    remainingDailyAllowance
    dailyCap
    tierLevel
    message
  }
}

actionCollections.name: JSUtils
